recommendations: Rachel Han “There aren't enough words to describe Julia's quality of work and her passion for what she does. Julia joined as an early engineer at Brex building integrations and had an impact across various teams within the Card product. She quickly scaled to become an engineering leader at the company, where she displayed a high level of emotional intelligence while empowering her team to do their best work. Outside of work, Julia has always embodied a growth mindset and takes action to learn about new topics to up-level herself. She doesn't hesitate to help people around her, and her impact goes a long way, in an out of work. I would be so lucky to work with Julia again!”

Melanie (Shaver) Aria “From the moment I met Julia through the Lean In CS&E Student Chapter, she has shown phenomenal leadership. Her ability to tell her story of her experience in CS, overcome challenges that come her way, express her passion towards women in engineering, and ability to connect well with others has helped in leading a Lean In CS&E Circle to success on her campus. She has gone above and beyond her role as a student and Circle Leader at Brown to also support the CS&E Chapter Leaders in being a guest speaker for two of our Campus Leader program cohorts. Her passion to help lead others to success through her experiences and advice leaves me with no doubt that she will be a great team player and colleague wherever she works. I look forward to seeing what she takes on next.”
